text:
MR::prime
Description
This iRule command establishes an outgoing connection to the specified
host or hosts using the specified transport. It instructs the Message
Routing Framework to establish an outgoing connection to a specified
host or pool if one does not exist. The setting of the specified
virtual or transport-config will be used to establish the connection.
If a pool is provided, outgoing connections will be created to all
active pool members of the specified pool.
Syntax
MR
::
prime
virtual
<
virtual_server_obj
>
MR
::
prime
config
<
transport_config
>
pool
<
pool_obj
>
MR
::
prime
host
<
host
>

CLIENT_ACCEPTED
